visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a rapid montage showing a woman with dark hair tied back, smiling while holding a long black dress in front of her body in a mirror. She is also seen holding a white tote bag with multiple small red heart patterns. The setting is a brightly lit clothing store with various garments on hangers and shelves in the background. (2) A transition reveals a wide shot of a calm lake surrounded by lush green grass and pine trees. A yellow pedal boat carrying two people glides across the water. In the background, a modern circular building with a glass facade stands near the shore under a bright blue sky with white clouds. (3) The scene cuts to the exterior of Karuizawa Station, a large white architectural structure with high windows. This is followed by a panoramic view of the Prince Shopping Plaza, showing vast green lawns, a lake, and low-rise commercial buildings with grey roofs and solar panels. (4) The camera moves indoors to show rows of neatly organized socks and leggings on display. A hand points to a detailed floor map of the shopping complex. The woman is seen again, trying on a straw hat and looking at her reflection while holding a smartphone to record herself. (5) Close-up shots feature specific products: a dark grey ruffled blouse, a red and white branded sock, and a black mesh pouch. Later, she is seen at a restaurant holding a piece of grilled meat with chopsticks over a plate of salad and rice. The video ends with a view of the mall's park-like grounds.

A female narrator with a bright, cheerful, and clear voice enters, speaking with moderate speed and friendly intonation. (2) The acoustic environment remains pristine, suggesting a studio-recorded voiceover. The music maintains a constant 4/4 energy. The narrator's pitch is medium-high, conveying excitement. (3) A subtle digital 'whoosh' SFX marks a visual transition halfway through, though the BGM and vocal delivery remain consistent and uninterrupted. (4) The narrator concludes with a call to action, accompanied by a soft melodic chime or 'ding' SFX. The music swells slightly in volume before fading out cleanly as the video concludes.

It emphasizes the convenience of the location and the quality of local food.
